answer: Resist sybils with a minimum bond that only unlocks after climbing a multi-epoch unbonding trellis. Each new identity posts that bond before it can earn or vote; withdrawals are delayed, and identities that share a funding path or near-identical work are merged into one slashable cluster. An attacker who lines up a farm at the registration wharf must freeze a marble of stake for every key and keep it locked for the whole window. One cluster verdict can burn all of those bonds together, so the cost is capital times delay plus total loss if caught, not the fee to create another address.
